description: This file defines the 'Scan' interface in Apache Spark, representing a logical data source scan with methods for obtaining schemas, descriptions, and different physical representations for batch and streaming modes, along with metrics and columnar support configurations.

classes.name: Scan
classes.description: A logical interface representing a data source scan in Spark, providing methods for schema retrieval, description, physical plan conversion for batch and streaming, metrics, and columnar support configuration.

classes.name: ColumnarSupportMode
classes.description: Enum defining support modes for columnar data processing: PARTITION_DEFINED, SUPPORTED, UNSUPPORTED.

methods.name: readSchema
methods.description: Returns the actual schema of the data source scan, which may differ from the physical storage schema due to optimizations.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Provides a string description of the scan, which can include filter and option details.

methods.name: toBatch
methods.description: Returns the batch physical plan; throws exception if not supported.

methods.name: toMicroBatchStream
methods.description: Returns the micro-batch streaming plan; throws exception if not supported.

methods.name: toContinuousStream
methods.description: Returns the continuous streaming plan; throws exception if not supported.

methods.name: supportedCustomMetrics
methods.description: Returns custom metrics supported by this scan.

methods.name: reportDriverMetrics
methods.description: Returns custom metrics collected at the driver side.

methods.name: columnarSupportMode
methods.description: Indicates how columnar support is determined for the scan.
